headline: Thomson Reserve Sells 90% of Units at $2,900 PSF Over Launch Weekend
summary: Thomson Reserve sold 90% of its residential units at an average price of $2,900 per square foot during its launch weekend, with buyers primarily being Singaporeans.
why: Singapore's private residential property market is closely watched by real estate investors as an indicator of domestic housing demand and liquidity.

impacts.name: Singapore Real Estate
impacts.why: Strong weekend launch absorption rate of 90%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
